role: §1983 defendant — person acting under color of state authority via orchestration of state actors (APD, court mediators, CPS); §1985 co-conspirator
theory_of_liability: Private party who conspired with and directed state actors to deprive steward of constitutionally protected liberty interest in custody of his child. Dispatcher training (SURCOMM/CENCOMM/NORCOM 2008-2015) provided knowledge of how to weaponize state systems. The §1985 conspiracy claim does not require state action — only that two or more persons conspired to deprive equal protection.
immunity_analysis: None. Private parties have no qualified or absolute immunity under §1983.
